verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions a self-hosted or on-premises deployment option. The only related material is data export and API access, which are adjacent features, not self-hosting. Capsule is described only as a hosted service reached via api.capsulecrm.com.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
